title: Local Plan Record
description: A local plan record aligned with the planning.data.gov.uk local-plan dataset: https://digital-land.github.io/specification/dataset/local-plan/
$comment: Reviewed against the planning.data.gov.uk local-plan-boundary specification on 2026-10-16.

reference.description: A reference for the local plan that is unique within the dataset and permanent.

name.description: The official name of the local plan.

description.description: A brief description of the plan.

adopted-date.description: The date the plan was adopted.

period-start-date.description: The start date of the period the plan covers.

period-end-date.description: The end date of the period the plan covers.

local-plan-boundary.description: The reference for the boundary the plan covers, matching a record in the local-plan-boundary dataset.

local-plan-process.description: The plan-making process the plan is prepared under, from the local-plan-process dataset.

local-planning-authorities.description: The local planning authorities the plan covers.

organisation.description: The organisation responsible for the record.

organisations.description: The organisations responsible for the local plan.

required-housing.description: The minimum number of homes the plan expects to be provided during the plan period.

document-url.description: The URL of the plan document.

documentation-url.description: The web page where the documentation for the plan can be found.

notes.description: Notes on how the data was made or how it can be interpreted.

entry-date.description: The date this information was entered as a record.

start-date.description: The date the validity of the record starts.

end-date.description: The date the validity of the record ends.

date.description: A date as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

curie.description: A compact identifier made of a prefix, a colon and a reference, such as local-authority:BUC.
